roleContext.jobDescription: Every document the company's customers upload passes through the search indexing pipeline before it can be found, and the pipeline's index rebuilds are the operation that engineers fear most. The Software Engineer on the pipeline team writes the indexing jobs and the schema changes, proves each change on the replay corpus before it merges, brings index rebuilds through the rebuild checklist with the on-call engineer, answers the customer-facing teams' questions about indexing delays, and leaves a written boundary for every change. The rebuild go-ahead is the pipeline lead's. Reports to the pipeline lead; works with the search ranking team, the storage team and the customer-facing support engineers.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Software Engineer, Search Indexing Pipeline

## Experience

- Software engineer on the search indexing pipeline team of a document collaboration company from 2022, writing the indexing jobs and the schema changes for the document and comment indexes under the team's engineering standard, with each change on a merge request in my name.
- Proved every change on the replay corpus before merge, attaching the replay result to the merge request; the replay results for the last two years sit in the pipeline repository.
- Brought nine full index rebuilds through the rebuild checklist with the on-call engineer; the rebuild go-ahead was the pipeline lead's each time, recorded on the rebuild checklist.
- Answered the customer-facing support engineers' questions about indexing delays in the pipeline support channel, marking in each thread which answers were mine and which were referred to the pipeline lead.
- Left a written boundary and a hand-over note on every merge request, stating what the change did not cover and what the next engineer needed to know.

## Work samples

- Work sample: two merge requests with their replay results and boundary notes, one rebuild checklist with the pipeline lead's go-ahead, and one month of the pipeline support channel, with the repository references as a verification trail.
